# Nx Angular build fixture

This workspace contains two Angular applications and shared source libraries.
The checked-in `dist/apps` files and stats are generated by real production builds.
Go tests consume those artifacts without requiring Node or Nx.

Regenerate from this directory:

```sh
npm ci
npm run build
bundlecheck workspace summary --projects portal,admin-dashboard
```

Dependencies are locked in `package-lock.json`. Local dependencies and build
caches are ignored. Builds replace each app's output directory, including old
hashed chunks. Do not edit generated stats or bundles by hand.

The sources deliberately use heavy dependencies, CommonJS imports, and an eager
PDF route to exercise package attribution, suggestions, and initial/lazy traces.
Contributions reflect what survives optimization, not every source import.
